plain: A 1950s technical document from Oak Ridge, the nuclear laboratory in Tennessee, is said to discuss magnesium and bismuth. Michels mentions it briefly himself, among other documents on UFOs, in an episode about the Department of Energy and UFOs, giving no more detail than that.
